- Can Archer confirm which fields accept CSV bulk imports versus portal-only manual edits?

2) Redwood curates an evidence manifest (we'll push to the Drive link) and a short mapping doc for SOC 2 controls by 5/18.
3) Greenfield to confirm access & upload schedule after Archer confirms import options.

Hi Marcus / Elaine,

Thanks for the inventory — this is very helpful. Quick answers: 
- We support CSV-based QnA bulk import for the majority of question types (text/boolean/multiple choice). Attachments must be uploaded via the evidence API (multipart form).
- Per-file attachment limit: 100 MB; recommended batch size: <= 200 attachments per run to avoid timeouts.
- There is a documented upload endpoint: https://archer.example.com/api/v1/uploads and a rate-limit of 30 req/min for the evidence endpoint (we can open a higher quota for verified partners).

We reviewed redwood_archer_inventory_v1.xlsx and flagged ~14 questions that have freeform text answers requiring manual review. We'll export a CSV template for you by EOD 5/15.

I'll loop in our upload engineering alias (archer-upload@archer.io) if you want us to provision a temporary service account for test uploads.

— Sam (Archer Support)
archer.io

I'll attach the first manifest once it's ready. Marcus

Laura / Marcus — ok to proceed with the proposed cadence. A few security clarifications before production run: 

1) Evidence manifest requirements: every row must include control_id, artifact_type, S3_uri (encrypted at rest), sha256_checksum, uploader (redwood-service-account). We'll validate checksums after upload.
2) Redaction policy: screenshots containing user identifiers must have the identifier replaced with <redacted-id> and a note in the manifest explaining the redaction.
3) Access & KMS: Mina — please ensure the S3 prefix uses key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/archer-partner and that the upload IAM role is limited to PutObject and ListBucket on the specific prefix.

Sam (Archer) — please confirm you can accept an S3 presigned multipart workflow; we prefer presigned to avoid transferring keys directly.

If Archer confirms presigned flow, Marcus — go ahead and run two dry-run batches 5/20 09:00 PST and 11:30 PST. Production run 5/20 15:00 PST pending checksum validation.

— Ben
Head of InfoSec Integrations | Redwood Inference
